title: NextJS app router SSR - filters are empty on server
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

When using useRange/useCurrentRefinements/useRefinementLists, etc. They all return empty items on the server and on the initial rendering, only after a couple re-renders in the client it populates the values with the correct values.

useHits is the only one that seems to be actually returning the correct values both on client and on server side

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

Nextjs app router example is not working on code sandox, both local and in codesandox its getting stucked loading.

Happy to give a reproduction example if we manage to get that working
